spans.s: cl. 1. P. इङ्खति, इङ्खां-चकार, इङ्खिष्यति, इङ्खितुम्, to go, move, Dhātup. v, 26 and 27;

etym.s: [cf. Hib. imchim, ‘I go on, proceed, march?’]

spans.s:
or इङ्ख् cl. 1. P. (इङ्खति, इङ्खां-चकार, or ईङ्खति, ईङ्खां-चकार, इङ्खितुम् or ईङ्खितुम्)
to go, move, Dhātup. v, 28 :
Caus. ईङ्ख॑यति, to move backwards and forwards, move up and down, swing, RV.; AitBr.

or इङ्ख् cl. 1. P. (इङ्खति, इङ्खां-चकार, or ईङ्खति, ईङ्खां-चकार, इङ्खितुम् or ईङ्खितुम्)
to go, move, Dhātup. v, 28 :
Caus. ईङ्ख॑यति, to move backwards and forwards, move up and down, swing, RV.; AitBr.
moving, causing to flow or go.
